## Checks that passed (all 70 files)
- Generated-ness: all 70 are really generated.
  - The 66 skill-assembly copies: 58 carry the "Generated by fgOS skill assembly" header (or sit under a SKILL.md frontmatter with the header on line 19).
  - The 4 distill scripts under .agents and .claude are byte-identical (sha a0adc051) to core/skills/distill/scripts/distill.mjs.
  - docs/decisions/index.md names `fgos decision-index`. doc-registry.md carries a generated banner. doc-registry.json and enduser-docs-index.json come from `fgos doc-registry` and fgos-indexing (src/report/enduser-index*.mjs, src/setup/registrations.mjs).
  - No hand-maintained file is marked generated.
- No diff and no rollbackDiff is recorded on any of the 70 files.
- The 4 docs/* data files are parked only. They need a bounded state export and same-input generator parity, and nothing is hand-patched. That blocker is real.
- Every render-join carries a physical Step 4 prior join (`resolverWitness.prior`). 109 render-join refs in total.
- Sample of 14 render-join refs against their source owner: the passage is present in the source file, the same line in the copy sits exactly +1 line (the header), and the Step 4 source outcome is preserve, patch, or an inherited park. Examples: knowledge-registry-redesign (source parked), specs/runner.md (source patch), history/<feature>/CONTEXT.md (source preserve), 0026 decision (source parked dead-link). All consistent.
- Rejected dynamic tuples in the distill scripts (92 per script copy) are formatting or regex or scalar-guard operands. They do not construct document paths. Admitted ones are path operations, and they match the source record 1:1 (57 admitted in distill.mjs, 4 in migrate-porting-state-backfill.mjs).

## OUTCOME defects (rework)

Defect G1: generated copy parked while its source outcome is preserve. Counts below are references.
- Rule: generated outputs follow their source (L12-71 and L12-62). Same-passage items share one outcome. A copy must not diverge from the source record.
- Where it hits: 42 refs in the .agents and plugins copies of capability-catalog, executor-dispatch-fallback, planning-capability-awareness, fgos-coding-exploring (gate-mechanics, lock-decisions), fgos-coding-planning (SKILL.md, bootstrap-and-lane, verify-sync-and-gap), fgos-coding-shaping (SKILL.md `DISCUSSION.md#task-<slug>`), and fgos-coding-validating (SKILL.md, gate-auto-approve-mechanics).
  - In many of these files the same passage and span also has a render-join ref (inherited from Step 4). Example: reference-000001 is render-join and reference-000002 is parked for the same passage (capability-catalog.md lines 3-9, `docs/history/agent-coordination-foundation/plan.md`).
  - The Step 4 source edge is preserve (history target, not retiring). The parked ones are the Step 2 history-census edges (history-0xx) for the generated copy.
- Their blocker ("exact source slot parity must own this generated passage before regeneration", category step5-parity) is circular. Step 5 is the parity step, and a preserve source needs no regeneration.
- Correction: join each of these refs to the same source outcome as its sibling (render-join following preserve), keeping the parity receipt. Parked is wrong.
- Reference ids: reference-000002 and 000026-27 are examples. A full list comes from role=generated-surface, disposition=parked, whose source slot is preserve.

Defect G2 (same class): distill script copies.
- Files: .agents and .claude `distill/scripts/distill.mjs` (3 refs each) and `migrate-porting-state-backfill.mjs` (4 refs each). Plugins has no distill copy.
- The literal refs (`docs/distillery/state`, `docs/distillery`, `docs/distillery/`, `porting-log.md`, `state/porting/`) are parked, but the source refs on the same passages (reference-000285 to 000287 and the backfill equivalents) are preserve. 14 refs.
- Correction: render-join following source preserve.

Defect G3: no source slot, and the copy is parked on a missing owner.
- Files, 9 refs, with the same two plugins copies where noted:
  - catchup-self-recovery.md line 47, ref `docs/how-to/diagnose-a-verify-fail-post-merge-block-on-approve.md`. The copy is parked in .agents and plugins.
  - scope-and-reclaim.md, ref `docs/how-to/write-verify-for-a-skill-prose-change.md`. The copy is parked in .agents and plugins.
  - distill SKILL.md (`docs/distillery/` and `docs/distillery/deep-dives/<topic>.md`), consult-protocol.md (`docs/distillery/`, `docs/distillery/sources/`), and extract-rules.md (`docs/distillery/`).
- The source files hold the identical passage (catchup-self-recovery.md line 47 at the pin). But the Step 4 records have no edge for them, and the Step 5 source records have 0 references. So no source record owns the passage.
- For the two how-to refs, the legacy alias path does not exist at the pin, and the live target is under docs/knowledge/... (diagnose-a-verify-fail-post-merge-block-on-approve.md and write-verify-for-a-skill-prose-change.md). The rule "a live holder with the same passage means a patch, not a park" applies. The sibling Step 4 how-to refs (wire-a-skills-classify... and preserve-shell-escapes...) were patched in source and render-joined in the copies.
- Correction: give the source core/skills/... and domains/coding/skills/... passage a first-class record with a Phase 9 patch to the live docs/knowledge path. Then render-join the copies to it. For the docs/distillery refs, add source records (a runtime-created project-local area, likely preserve) and render-join the copies to them.
- Note: this part cannot fix it, because the Step 5 source records for these files need new author-added references. Flag it to Lead.
